title: Nutrition and Athletic Performance: Position of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, Dietitians of Canada, and the American College of Sports Medicine
claims: For a pre-event meal eaten more than 60 minutes before exercise, the guideline recommends 1-4 g/kg of carbohydrate consumed 1-4 hours before exercise, preferring low-fat, low-fibre foods to reduce gastrointestinal problems and promote gastric emptying.
The guideline recommends ensuring at least 1 g/kg of carbohydrate in the pre-event meal to compensate for increased carbohydrate oxidation.
Low-fat, low-fibre foods are preferred because they are less prone to cause gastrointestinal problems and promote gastric emptying.
具体份量需要按体重、运动时长、环境与个人耐受调整，不能把范围当成固定处方。

verification.note: ACSM/DC 2016 全文；2026-11-20 修正赛前餐时间窗（1–4 h 而非 3–4 h），删除无原文的“1–2 小时约 1 g/kg”，并把 GI 表述收窄到原文。

claimVerification.note: 原文/Table 2：>60 min，1–4 g/kg，1–4 h before；低脂、低纤维、低–中等蛋白“less prone to cause gastrointestinal problems and promote gastric emptying”。原 claim 的“3–4 小时”已改为 1–4 小时。
原文：“ensuring at least 1 g/kg carbohydrate in the pre-event meal to compensate for the increased carbohydrate oxidation”；该句不给“1–2 小时”时间窗。
原文只写“less prone to cause gastrointestinal problems and promote gastric emptying”；不扩写为运动中腹胀、恶心、腹泻。

原文：“Carbohydrate intakes of 1–4 g/kg, with timing, amount, and food choices suited to the individual”“Depending on characteristics including the type of exercise, the environment, and the athlete's preparation and carbohydrate tolerance”“the individual athlete should choose a strategy that suits their situation and their past experiences”。按体重（g/kg）、时长/运动类型、环境、个人耐受调整均有对应。
